key_findings: A synthetic CD14/TLR4 antagonist reduced tactile allodynia and heat hyperalgesia in rat osteoarthritic and postoperative pain models.
Peripheral TLR4 dominates incisional pain, while peripheral and central TLR4 both contribute to osteoarthritic pain.
